sloka: यत्तु कार्यम् मनुष्येण शौण्डीर्यमवलम्ब्यताम् ।तदलम्करणायैव कर्तुर्भवति सत्वरम् ॥६-२-१५॥।।
transliteration: yattu kāryam manuṣyeṇa śauṇḍīryamavalambyatām ।tadalamkaraṇāyaiva karturbhavati satvaram ॥6-2-15॥।।

translations.english: "Just as heroism follows a human being in this world on accomplishing a task, you who are very wise, should resort to courage and valour and rise up."
